description: This file contains implementation of utility functions related to logging and file name processing within the Thunder::Core namespace, including functions for extracting file name from a path, creating log messages, and retrieving the program name on Windows.

methods.name: FileNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts the filename from a given file path, handling both '/' and '\' as directory separators.

methods.name: LogMessage
methods.description: Constructs a log message string with filename, line number, and message, supporting Unicode and non-Unicode builds.

methods.name: GetProgramName
methods.description: Retrieves the executable's filename on Windows, caching the result for subsequent calls.
